notes.title: Age of Castles: Warlords trading cards have arrived!
notes.notes:
We have released the official Age of Castles: Warlords trading cards which are now available on Steam. 

Includes: 
- 8 Unique Trading Cards! 
- 4 Background Themes! 
- 5 Emoticons! 
- Cool Badges to earn! 

Build your kingdom in Age of Castles: Warlords and start collecting the trading cards today!
